newsitem.title: USA: National Lending merges into IMC Mortgage.
newsitem.headline: National Lending merges into IMC Mortgage.

text.p: IMC Mortgage Co said Deerfield Beach, Fla.-based National Lending Center Inc has agreed to merge into the IMC family of companies.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The company said it expects it to close in early July.

George Nicholas, chairman of IMC, remarked in a statement: "We are very familiar and comfortable with the quality of loans originated by (National Lending), having purchased their loans in the past. We are confident of the benefits apparent from this acquisition."
National Lending originates loans primarily through mortgage brokers and has operations in 17 states throughout the U.S. Its total loan volume exceeded $250 million in 1996.
IMC has wholesale and retail operations in the U.S. and began limited operations in early 1996 in the United Kingdom through a joint venture.
